column3: BSB reorders “for the people … for himself.”
BSB adds “He was called by” and renders “today I have begotten You” as “today I have become Your Father.”
BSB renders “the days of His flesh” as “the days of Jesus’ earthly life.”
BSB renders “sluggish in the hearings” as “dull of hearing.”
BSB renders “the oracles of God” as “God’s word” and divides the verse into sentences.
